_column_contract: Summit's cover box runs Current | Last(=Previous, 2024 sheet) | Cumulative — the REVERSE of the parsed cities' sheet. All three columns are captured VERBATIM and LABELLED here; the builder promotes one per the rule documented in CLAUDE.md. "" = the cell was EMPTY (or a slashed-zero / dash nil mark) on the form; null = a value is present but ILLEGIBLE and was never guessed.

contributions.detail: exact - 4 rows sum to 1,503.02 = the cover's stated contribution total (current = cumulative on this Primary filing); the schedule page prints no total of its own. The 303.02 self-contribution on 2/28/22 is the same figure and same date as the p3 Summit County Clerk FILING FEE expenditure - the candidate funded his own filing fee, which independently corroborates both the amount and the date.

expenditures.detail: exact - 2 rows (303.02 + 36.15) sum to 339.17 = the page's OWN printed box 'Total amount of expenditures' AND the cover.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: p2 ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT (2022 sheet, Date/Name/Mailing Address/Zip Code/Amount) prints NO section total of its own - the gate is the cover's stated contribution figure 1,503.02, which the 4 handwritten rows reproduce to the cent. p3 ITEMIZED EXPENSE REPORT prints its own boxed 'Total amount of expenditures 339.17' above the grid, matching the cover; the 2 rows reproduce it to the cent. No specimen rows survive on either page (this filer used the blank grid).

geometry.basis: rule-detection row banding (rowbands.py) on the page's own printed grid; box spans the full table width of the row

_meta_itemized.notes: Handwritten entries on the typed 2022 single_total sheet, 3 pages. No embedded text layer for the ledger pages (draft.py returned zero words on both), so both pages were read full-page at 200 dpi and every doubtful cell escalated with a tight --value crop at 1400 dpi. NOT REDACTED: unlike several other 2022 Summit filings, the county left this filing's Mailing Address / Zip Code columns intact, so donor_city/donor_state are read from the filer's own address text and the street/PO-box portion was discarded at read time (never written here). The filer abbreviates Park City as 'PC' - kept verbatim, never expanded. ESCALATIONS (3): (1) the day digit of the 2/28/22 date in contribution line 1 is over-inked (the loop is filled solid) and stays ambiguous at 1400 dpi - it is read as 28 and carried at cell_confidence date=low; the same over-inked glyph recurs on p3 line 1, and 2/28/2022 is a plausible Summit filing-week date, but no arithmetic can settle a date so it is flagged rather than asserted; (2) the surname in contribution line 3 escalated to 1400 dpi and remains a one-glyph ambiguity between 'Parry' and 'Berry' - the capital shows a single bowl so it is transcribed 'Nick Parry' at name=low; (3) geometry spot-verified end to end - the materializer's resolved band boxes p2 band 5 and p3 band 3 crop back to 'Para O'Reilly ... 1000.00' and 'PayPal / Campaign Expense (processing fee) / 36.15'.
